KelvinRGB sensor and fan helper: third-party libraries

These files ship in resources\sidecar\lib next to sidecar.exe, unmodified, as published on nuget.org.

LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6    MPL-2.0      https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor
BlackSharp.Core 1.0.7            MPL-2.0      https://github.com/Blacktempel/BlackSharp
DiskInfoToolkit 1.1.2            MPL-2.0      https://github.com/Blacktempel/DiskInfoToolkit
RAMSPDToolkit-NDD 1.4.2          MPL-2.0      https://github.com/Blacktempel/RAMSPDToolkit
HidSharp 2.6.4                   Apache-2.0   https://software.seekye.com/hidsharp   (HidSharp-LICENSE.txt)
System.* (.NET libraries)        MIT          https://github.com/dotnet/runtime      (dotnet-LICENSE.txt)

Source Code Form of the MPL-2.0 libraries: the project pages above, at the versions listed. The full MPL-2.0
text is in MPL-2.0.txt in this folder.
